name: Measure length to the nearest millimetre
short_description: Measure length to the nearest millimetre once under stated everyday conditions without assistance.
self_assessment: I can measure length to the nearest millimetre in one repeatable attempt without help.
description: Measure length to the nearest millimetre means carrying out this capability under ordinary, stated conditions without another person completing any part. Practice focuses on the observable result, the threshold in the self-assessment, and repeatability across more than one occasion. The capability includes selecting an appropriate approach, completing the action, and checking the outcome. It excludes brand-specific steps, credentials, unrelated habits, and one-off achievements.
examples: Measure length to the nearest millimetre in a fresh real-life scenario.
